text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding cust Alcyone LoRA merge to int4 runtime for a quick smoke. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alcyone-lora/pull/42  Need a quick look on invoice extraction tests, could be tokenization-related. Anyone free to kick off the eval pack? :eyes:
aj: I can run it now. grabbing the model + int4 build, will run invoices_v2 and the small QA list. Posting command and raw output when done.

aj: Running:
```bash
./run_eval.sh --model alcyone-lora-merged --quant int4 --eval-set invoices_v2 --backends runtime-intel64 --out /tmp/alcyone_int4_results.json\```

eval-bot: Automated run started for thread 1765559998 — queued on runner-07. ETA ~6m.

aj: Raw quick summary: token-likelihood shift +1.2% (vs int8 baseline), invoice-field F1 dropped 3.4 pts, date extraction precision -4.1 pts, hallucination rate +0.6%. Full JSON: /tmp/alcyone_int4_results.json

lucas: Hmm, +1.2% token-likelihood skew often indicates tokenizer mismatch with LoRA's training tokenizer. Was the LoRA trained against the updated vocab?

maria: Good call — patch notes say they used base tokenizer v2.0, our runtime uses v2.1 (merges/old tokens changed). That could explain align/offset in bytepair splits.

samir: If it's tokenizer drift, two quick options: 1) remap token ids at load time, 2) fall back to int8 for this customer while we patch tokenizer compat. What's the customer SLA on rollout?

maria: Customer is on a tight SLA — prefer avoiding user-visible regressions. Let's pin them to int8 for the immediate rollout and schedule a canary for int4 after a tokenizer compatibility patch + smoke.

lucas: I can prototype a remap shim. Small patch idea: on model load, if vocab mismatch detected, run a token-alias map that maps old ids -> new ids for embeddings and kv layout. Quick PoC:```python
# pseudocode
if model.vocab_hash != runtime.vocab_hash:
    alias = build_token_alias(model.vocab, runtime.vocab)
    model.embeddings = model.embeddings[alias.indices]
    remap_kv_cache_keys(alias)
```
Will test locally, but need to ensure KV-cache ordering preserved for long context.

aj: I reran with int8 quickly for comparison. int8 summary: token-likelihood skew ~0.0%, F1 drop 0.2 pts — acceptable. So fallback works.

maria: OK, plan: (1) pin customer route to int8 for rollout (ops ticket), (2) lucas to iterate on remap shim and run targeted smoke (small eval pack + long-context invoice samples), (3) aj to run a canary int4 with remap once available. I'll open the rollout ticket.

samir: Also add an eval label for "tokenizer-compat" to the PR so QA can run specialized tests.

lucas: One more note — if we remap embeddings we must re-run a small recalibration of quantization scales (int4 kernels are sensitive). I'll include a tiny recalibration step in PoC.

maria: Great. Thanks everyone. Adding follow-ups: ops ticket #INC-3142, PR 42 linked above, I'll schedule a 11am sync tomorrow if needed. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: Run completed for invoices_v2; artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/alcyone/1765559998/results.json

aj: linking short logs for debugging:
```
[2026-02-10T14:12:33Z] runner-07: loading model alcyone-lora-merged (quant=int4)
[2026-02-10T14:12:34Z] vocab_hash(load)=0x7f2a9b, runtime_vocab_hash=0x8c3d1e
[2026-02-10T14:12:35Z] WARN tokenizer: unknown token ids found, remapping suggested
[2026-02-10T14:18:50Z] eval: invoices_v2 run complete, 240 cases processed
```

maria: Perfect. We'll avoid shipping int4 to the customer until remap+recalibration smoke passes. Closing thread for now, will update when PoC lands.
